title: Bound-matrix suite
purpose: Exercise each declared DecodeLimits member at, below, and above its value, assert the declared failed/rejected classification with no decoded value on a breach, and assert every limit below 1 fails closed.
inputs: small valid two-item collection vectors with adjusted caps
outputs: accept at the bound and fail-closed over it
errors: assertion failure on an accepted breach or a returned value
invariants: no production numeric bound value fixed

unit_cases.precondition: max_bytes set to the fixture length and one byte less
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the byte bound
unit_cases.expected: at accepts; over failed XCOM-DECODE-BOUND with no plan (T20-BND-01)

unit_cases.precondition: a document exactly at max_depth and one level deeper
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the depth bound

unit_cases.precondition: a document exactly at max_nodes and one node more
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the node bound

unit_cases.precondition: a decoded string one byte over max_string_length
a valid two-contract plan with max_contracts 2 then 1
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the contract cap

unit_cases.precondition: a valid two-endpoint plan with max_endpoints 2 then 1
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the endpoint cap

unit_cases.precondition: a valid two-route plan with max_routes 2 then 1
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the route cap

unit_cases.precondition: a valid two-provider plan with max_providers 2 then 1
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over the provider cap

unit_cases.precondition: max_observation_points and max_clock_domains at and one below the plan count
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over each cap

unit_cases.precondition: max_diagnostics, max_activation_order, max_provenance_resources at and one below
unit_cases.stimulus: decode at and over each cap

unit_cases.precondition: each of the 13 DecodeLimits members set to 0

static_checks.rule: cppcheck --error-exitcode=1 --quiet --std=c++20 --language=c++ --suppress=invalidLifetime src/xverse/xcom/src/activation_plan.cpp reports no error/portability defect in the consumed T019 decoder source built into the T020 suites

static_checks.tool: GNU g++ 11.4.0 via CMake target xverse_xcom_activation_plan_t020_<kind>_tests with xverse_xcom_apply_warnings
static_checks.rule: the T020 test target compiles under the project strict warning flags with no warning and no error
